description: Shared paired-machine vault protocol cases. Driven by src/services/machineVault.test.ts (browserVault) and by the tests in src-tauri/src/machine.rs. Each step calls one vault operation, lists the HTTP exchanges it must perform in order, and gives the expected result or error code. A case with "paired": true runs paired_setup first. Only behaviour both implementations share belongs here; platform-specific behaviour is tested on its own side.
